A memory returned by retrieval, with the signals a consumer needs to weigh it.

``freshness`` is ``"unverified"`` for low-confidence or conflicted memories and ``"stale"``

info.description:
AgentOS: an action-taking, tool-using, self-verifying AI agent platform. LLM proposes. Backend decides. Tools execute. Verifier confirms.

All endpoints except auth and health require `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Errors use the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}`.
